data.indexFullNameCn: 中证申万有色金属指数
data.indexCnDesc: 中证申万有色金属指数从沪深市场申万有色金属及非金属材料行业中选取50只上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映沪深市场有色金属行业上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI SWS Non-ferrous Metal Index selects 50 securities which belong to SWS Non-ferrous metal and Non-metallic materials industry as constituents. The index is to measure the performance of Non-ferrous industry.
